raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 contains a second delivery at 05:00 that re-sends 333 transactions already delivered at 02:00. The copies are identical except that txn_ts is in epoch-milliseconds form; for example, 1768716039000 equals 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC, matching the original row. The epoch values crash the TIMESTAMP cast, and they would also double-count those transactions if simply parsed.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]{13}') THEN epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]{13}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_epoch FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY is_epoch, ingest_ts) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
